anchor.address: Avinguda Meridiana, Fabra i Puig, Barcelona

reference.streetview_capture: Photos taken on the avenue at night, October 2026 (shared in chat, not committed); openly licensed photos and the city's reform notes, 2026-10-30 (docs/places/meridiana.md)
notes: MAP DATA: OpenStreetMap (osm.json, fetched 2026-10-22) for the blocks, cross streets, trees, lamps, benches, bins, bike racks, shops and zebra crossings. The avenue's own carriageways are redrawn in sketch.json (`redraw`) as the cross-section after the works.
Turned -62°: the Meridiana runs left to right, Fabra i Puig on the left, Hipercor (Meridiana 350-356) on the right; the even side, with the shops, faces the camera.
Sidewalk: renewed, light grey panot tiles in a square grid, wide; square tree pits with dark soil and fallen leaves; metal grates.
Trees: plane trees with pale, mottled trunks along the curb; young trees held by three wooden stakes with crossbars in the new beds.
Beds: long planted strips of low shrubs and grasses along the curb and on both sides of the bike lane in the median.
Roads: new black asphalt, white dashed lanes, zebra crossings, BUS painted on the side road's bus lane; white bike symbol and dashed centre line on the bike lane.

Furniture: wooden benches and single chairs with grey metal frames, tall slim grey LED lamps, traffic lights with yellow housings on curved poles, a bus shelter with a yellow roof and seat, bins, bikes locked to poles.
Works: red and white plastic barriers everywhere, white sacks of rubble, yellow and metal fence panels, a long metal hoarding covered in graffiti.

Buildings: beige and cream blocks of flats of eight to eleven storeys with shops on the ground floor (Granier, 365, Vision-Prix, General Óptica, Al Meu BB, Café Entrepans, Zamora Floristas, a 1 € shop by home); orange blocks across the avenue; Hipercor's beige box with its wavy concrete canopy and blue lit letters, a dark tower behind it.
Traffic: TMB red buses and white Sagalés coaches; few cars.
The flat's exact portal is not known: home is the corner block by the Fabra i Puig metro entrance (open question in docs/chapter-2.md).

WORKS (2026-10-30, beteve.cat and Ajuntament): this stretch is the Felip II–Fabra i Puig phase of the Meridiana reform, begun in April 2025 for 18 months: two general lanes and a bus lane each way, a two-way bike lane in a central planted median with a double row of trees, wider sidewalks with beds, about 275 new trees and 7,200 m² of beds, crossings from 9 to 15. October 2026 is its last weeks.

CROSS-SECTION: OpenStreetMap (2026-10-22) agrees: east carriageway centred at z≈5 and west at z≈20 (3 lanes, one a bus lane, 12 m each), the bike lane under construction at z≈13 (4 m), the old kerb-line plane trees at z≈-7 and the new bed's trees at z≈-1, the west trees at z≈28–32. Six lanes in all, as Gerard says; the sketch's side road plus 3 + 3 lanes (eight) is to be redrawn (docs/places/meridiana.md).

HIPERCOR (CC0 photo, 2022): a white scalloped canopy, a row of shallow vaults, over light panels with thin blue vertical stripes, HIPERCOR in blue on a white sign; recycling containers and benches in front. Behind it rise the rental slabs of 15–17 storeys (OSM relation/8938011, 8938019, 8938017, x 122–348 z −109…−80) with dark brown spandrels and white ribbon windows: the 'dark tower' of the night photos is the nearest of them.

BLOCKS (openly licensed photos of the avenue): cream render or tan facing brick, continuous balcony slabs with white or aluminium railings, enclosed aluminium galleries, green and grey canvas awnings, set-back top floors, bare brick party walls (mitgeres) where heights change; flat terraces with stair and lift housings, water tanks, aerials, air conditioners and washing.

FURNITURE a local knows: curved grey poles with yellow traffic lights, the grey, yellow, blue, green and brown recycling containers in a row by the kerb, Bicing docks (OSM: Av. Meridiana 404, Concepció Arenal 176), motorbikes parked on the sidewalk, the ONCE kiosk, a newsstand.

UNDER THE AVENUE: the L1 and the Rodalies tunnel (R3, R4, R7); the Renfe station is now Barcelona-Fabra i Puig (OSM), once Sant Andreu Arenal; the L1 also comes up at Concepció Arenal (OSM entrances at x≈−24 and x≈6, z≈−7).
LEFT OUT on purpose: the 1987 bombing memorial and the avenue's protests; nothing tragic or political in a birthday game.

places.label: Mirar la avenida
lines: La Meridiana. Seis carriles, y hoy apenas pasa un coche.
La gente está parada en las aceras, mirando todos hacia el norte. Hacia Trinitat Vella.

places.label: Mirar el Granier
lines: El Granier. Huele a cruasán recién hecho.
La dependienta ha salido a la puerta con el delantal puesto. Mira hacia el norte, como todo el mundo.

places.label: Mirar el Hipercor
lines: El Hipercor, con las puertas abiertas y nadie entrando.
Hasta el guardia de seguridad ha salido a mirar hacia Trinitat Vella.

places.label: Mirar las obras
lines: Las obras de la Meridiana. Vallas rojas y blancas, sacos de escombros y la mediana a medio plantar.
Los árboles nuevos aún van atados a sus palos.

places.label: Mirar los grafitis
lines: Una valla de obra llena de grafitis. Firmas, letras gordas, un gato.
Y en medio, una pompa de chicle rosa enorme. Esa no estaba ayer.
